package.description: Interact with the Personal Identity Verification (PIV) application on a YubiKey.

en-US.description: Interact with the Personal Identity Verification (PIV) application on a YubiKey.
en-US.longDescription:
The Yubico PIV tool is used for interacting with the Personal Identity Verification (PIV) application on a YubiKey.
With it you may generate keys on the device, importing keys and certificates, and create certificate requests, and other operations. A shared library and a command-line tool is included.
en-US.name: Yubico PIV Tool

zh-CN.description: 与 YubiKey 上的个人身份验证（PIV）应用进行交互。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Yubico PIV Tool 用于与 YubiKey 上的个人身份验证（PIV）应用进行交互。
通过该工具，您可以在设备上生成密钥、导入密钥和证书、创建证书请求以及执行其他操作。工具包含一个共享库和一个命令行程序。
